Label data

rr #Add language variable in each df_english <- df_english %>% mutate(language = )

df_farsi <- df_farsi %>% mutate(language = )

df_chinese <- df_chinese %>% mutate(language = )

df_chinese_pca0 <- df_chinese %>% mutate(gender = 0) df_chinese_pca1 <- df_chinese_pca1 %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = 1)

df_wolof <- df_wolof %>% mutate(language = )

df_arabic <- df_arabic %>% mutate(language = ) df_arabic_combo <- df_arabic %>% mutate(Arabic = ) %>% mutate(gender = Equally) df_arabic_weighted_simple <- df_arabic_weighted_simple %>% mutate(language = ) df_arabic_weighted <- df_arabic_weighted %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(Arabic = ) %>% mutate(gender = By Word Count) df_arabic_female <- df_arabic_female %>% mutate(language = ) %>% mutate(gender = ) df_arabic_male <- df_arabic_male %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = ) df_arabic_neutral <- df_arabic_neutral %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = )

df_spanish <- df_spanish %>% mutate(language = ) df_spanish_combo <- df_spanish %>% mutate(Spanish = ) %>% mutate(gender = Equally) df_spanish_weighted_simple <- df_spanish_weighted_simple %>% mutate(language = ) df_spanish_weighted <- df_spanish_weighted %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(Spanish = ) %>% mutate(gender = By Word Count) df_spanish_female <- df_spanish_female %>% mutate(language = ) %>% mutate(gender = ) df_spanish_male <- df_spanish_male %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = ) df_spanish_neutral <- df_spanish_neutral %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = )

df_french <- df_french %>% mutate(language = ) df_french_combo <- df_french %>% mutate(French = ) %>% mutate(gender = Equally) df_french_weighted_simple <- df_french_weighted_simple %>% mutate(language = ) df_french_weighted <- df_french_weighted %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(French = ) %>% mutate(gender = By Word Count) df_french_female <- df_french_female %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = ) df_french_male <- df_french_male %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = ) df_french_neutral <- df_french_neutral %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = )

df_german <- df_german %>% mutate(language = ) df_german_combo <- df_german %>% mutate(German = ) %>% mutate(gender = Equally) df_german_weighted_simple <- df_german_weighted_simple %>% mutate(language = ) df_german_weighted <- df_german_weighted %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(German = ) %>% mutate(gender = By Word Count) df_german_female <- df_german_female %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = ) df_german_male <- df_german_male %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = ) df_german_neutral <- df_german_neutral %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = )

df_urdu <- df_urdu %>% mutate(language = ) df_urdu_combo <- df_urdu %>% mutate(Urdu = ) %>% mutate(gender = Equally) df_urdu_weighted_simple <- df_urdu_weighted_simple %>% mutate(language = ) df_urdu_weighted <- df_urdu_weighted %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(Urdu = ) %>% mutate(gender = By Word Count) df_urdu_female <- df_urdu_female %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = ) df_urdu_male <- df_urdu_male %>% mutate(language = ) %>% mutate(gender = ) df_urdu_neutral <- df_urdu_neutral %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = ) df_urdu_english <- df_urdu_english %>% mutate(language = )%>% mutate(gender = Words Used in Urdu (Neutral))

Combine data

rr df_total <- rbind(df_english, df_chinese, df_arabic, df_spanish, df_german, df_farsi, df_french, df_urdu, df_wolof)

df_total_weighted <- rbind(df_english, df_chinese, df_arabic_weighted_simple, df_farsi, df_french_weighted_simple, df_urdu_weighted_simple, df_wolof, df_spanish_weighted_simple, df_german_weighted_simple)

df_gendered_languages <-rbind(df_spanish, df_german, df_arabic, df_french, df_urdu)

df_gendered_languages_weighted <-rbind(df_spanish_weighted_simple, df_german_weighted_simple, df_french_weighted_simple, df_arabic_weighted_simple, df_urdu_weighted_simple)

df_nongendered_languages<-rbind(df_english, df_chinese, df_farsi, df_wolof)

df_spanish_all <-rbind(df_spanish_female, df_spanish_male, df_spanish_neutral, df_spanish_combo, df_spanish_weighted) df_french_all <-rbind(df_french_female, df_french_male, df_french_neutral, df_french_combo, df_french_weighted) df_german_all <-rbind(df_german_female, df_german_male, df_german_neutral, df_german_combo, df_german_weighted)

df_arabic_all <-rbind(df_arabic_female, df_arabic_male, df_arabic_neutral, df_arabic_combo, df_arabic_weighted) df_urdu_all <-rbind(df_urdu_female, df_urdu_male, df_urdu_neutral, df_urdu_english, df_urdu_combo, df_urdu_weighted)

df_chinese_all <-rbind(df_chinese_pca0, df_chinese_pca1)

Visualizations

Basic bar chart

rr ggplot(data = df_english, aes(x = professions, y = gender_bias)) + geom_bar(stat = )

Add color for bias

rr ggplot(data = df_english, aes(x = professions, y = gender_bias, fill = pos)) + geom_bar(stat = )

Flip coordinates

rr ggplot(data = df_english, aes(x = professions, y = gender_bias, fill = pos)) + geom_bar(stat = ) + coord_flip()

Add title/axis label

rr ggplot(data = df_english, aes(x = professions, y = gender_bias, fill = pos)) + geom_bar(stat = ) + coord_flip() + labs(title = Set (English Only), y = Measure, x = element_blank())

Change color

rr ggplot(data = df_english, aes(x = professions, y = gender_bias, fill = pos)) + geom_bar(stat = ) + coord_flip() + labs(title = Set (English Only), y = Measure, x = element_blank()) + scale_fill_manual(values = c( 2, 2))

Change axis to be balanced

rr ggplot(data = df_english, aes(x = professions, y = gender_bias, fill = pos)) + geom_bar(stat = ) + coord_flip() + labs(title = Set (English Only), y = Measure, x = element_blank()) + scale_fill_manual(values = c( 2, 2)) + expand_limits(y = c(-.3, 0.3))

Mess with "Theme" (delete legend, change font, center title) - FINAL VERSION in ENGLISH?

rr pEnglish=ggplot(data = df_english, aes(x = professions, y = gender_bias, fill = pos)) + geom_bar(stat = ) + coord_flip() + labs(title = Set (English), y = Measure, x = element_blank()) + scale_fill_manual(values = c( 2, 2)) + expand_limits(y = c(-.3, 0.3)) + theme( legend.position = , text = element_text(family = Sans), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5) ) ggsave(file = _English.png, pEnglish)
